how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-wetlands-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:289:obj:0: Kill 13 Cursed Sailors, 5 Cursed Marines and First Mate Snellig. Bring ⟦E1⟧ to First Mate Fitzsimmons in Menethil ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:289:details:1: I am the sole survivor of the ill-fated Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, wrecked off the coast to the north. But although I'm the only member of the fleet still breathing, I'm not the only one still walking about! For on one of our ships was hidden a great, and terrible treasure, and the eerie power of it keeps the souls of my brothers trapped within the ships' rotting hulls.
rows.quest:289:details:2: But if you can free some of my brothers, then perhaps you can break their ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:289:progress:0: In my dreams, I can sometimes hear the doomed moans of my brethren! Please, good sir, free them from the bonds and quiet their cries.
rows.quest:289:completion:0: My thanks to you, ⟦1⟧. And the gratitude of my cursed brethren goes to you as well.
rows.quest:296:obj:0: Ormer Ironbraid at the Whelgar Excavation Site wants you to kill Sarltooth and return to him with one of his talons once the task is fulfilled.
rows.quest:296:details:0: While you were down there I happened to notice that one of those beasts stood out from the rest. He was bigger and more menacing. I bet he's the one who led the others here to cause the disruption to the dig site.
rows.quest:296:details:1: I ask of you now one final task, ⟦2⟧. See to it that Sarltooth is brought to justice. And considering the gravity of his crimes, justice in this case means death! Bring me one of his talons as proof of his death.
rows.quest:296:progress:0: Is Sarltooth dead? Have you redeemed the memory of the fallen?
rows.quest:296:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦3⟧. Your efforts here will not be forgotten. Many innocent ⟦E4⟧ died at this site, simply doing their jobs. The vengeance you delivered to those evil creatures should make them think twice before attacking King Magni's subjects ever again.

rows.quest:290:obj:1: ⟦E9⟧ the key to open the Intrepid's Locked Strongbox.
rows.quest:290:details:0: To break the ⟦E3⟧ and free all of my brethren, the...thing...stowed on my ship must be retrieved and cleansed! I don't know what it was, but I do know that it was stored securely in the ship's strongbox, which Captain Halyndor lorded over.
rows.quest:290:details:1: My old captain is still in my dreams. I know he walks my doomed ship, the Intrepid. Get the key from him, and use it to open the Intrepid's strongbox.
rows.quest:290:details:2: Then, after you have the cursed thing, bring it to the priest Glorin Steelbrow in town.
rows.quest:290:completion:0: The key is rusted but it fits the lock neatly.
rows.quest:292:details:0: Opening the chest reveals a blackened orb, pulsing with an eerie light. It is the treasure of which Fitzsimmons spoke: a ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:292:details:1: Take the ⟦E10⟧ to the dwarven priest Glorin Steelbrow, in Menethil ⟦E2⟧. Ask him how to remove the Eye's ⟦E3⟧.

rows.quest:292:completion:0: An ⟦E11⟧? Amazing! Hmm... there's something wrong with this one. You found it on one of those shipwrecks? Well that explains it! But... I didn't know they had such an Eye on the Third Fleet...

rows.quest:293:obj:0: Bring Archbishop Benedictus the ⟦E10⟧. Benedictus is in the Cathedral of Light, in the city of ⟦E12⟧.

rows.quest:293:progress:0: What is that orb you have? It looks...soiled.
rows.quest:293:completion:0: An ⟦E11⟧. But this one has seen much sorrow...it must have been witness to a terrible, terrible tragedy.
rows.quest:293:completion:1: Let me cleanse it, for the Eyes were created to shine bright, and their powers can be quite dangerous if tainted like this one.
rows.quest:303:obj:0: Motley Garmason at Dun Modr wants you to kill 10 Dark Iron ⟦E4⟧, 5 Dark Iron Tunnelers, 5 Dark Iron Saboteurs and 5 Dark Iron Demolitionists.
rows.quest:303:details:0: War rages both home and abroad. While mighty Dwarven soldiers give their lives in far off territories in the name of the ⟦E14⟧, our own lands fall prey to the evil deeds of the Dark Iron ⟦E4⟧. They laid waste to the Thandol Span. Dun Modr fell soon after.
rows.quest:303:details:1: We need you to gather force and push the front back. If you can kill 10 Dark Iron ⟦E4⟧, 5 Tunnelers, 5 Saboteurs and 5 Demolitionists, the reserve might arrive in time to finish the drive.
rows.quest:303:progress:0: Roggo has been unable to contact the reserve forces. We need offensive pressure on that Dark Iron encampment, ⟦4⟧. Now get back out there and serve your duty to King Magni!
rows.quest:303:completion:0: You upheld your orders well, ⟦5⟧. You have proven yourself to be a valiant soldier and loyal servant to King Magni and for that I salute you! With the pressure you applied to the Dark Iron encampment, we now stand a ⟦E15⟧ of driving them off our lands for good. . .if only the damned reserve would show. . . .
rows.quest:472:obj:0: Search for Longbraid near the town of Dun Modr.

rows.quest:472:details:1: My ⟦E16⟧ are grave, ⟦6⟧. Most of the regiment was killed! The Dark Iron thugs attacked us before we could regroup from the Thandol Span ambush.
rows.quest:472:details:2: Our leader, Longbraid, sounded the retreat horn. As we left the town I was ⟦E17⟧ by a stray axe in the back. All went black.
rows.quest:472:details:3: I awoke here in Menethil but I ⟦E18⟧ for my fellow soldiers. ⟦E19⟧ still burns within me. Perhaps Longbraid is still alive! See if you can find him near Dun Modr, ⟦7⟧!
rows.quest:472:completion:0: What brave ⟦8⟧ sends word from Menethil? Ah ⟦9⟧, they call you.
rows.quest:472:completion:1: You bring hope to a hopeless situation. 'Tis good news indeed that young Harlo survived. While fleeing he received a grievous wound. We had but little time to send him on his way on the back of the only surviving steed with the regiment.
rows.quest:472:completion:2: But now we face a perilous situation. Dun Modr has fallen and we are but a shadow of the great regiment we once were.
rows.quest:647:details:0: Had quite a bit of the ol' Moonshine last night! Longbraid would have my head if he knew that I passed out during my watch.
rows.quest:647:details:1: The noggin hurts something fierce. Felt as though a whole brigade of siege engines passed overhead, all that rumbling.
rows.quest:647:details:2: Oh my, look at the time! I promised Brewmeister Bilger in ⟦E21⟧ that I'd repay my debt to him by sending some Moonshine.
rows.quest:647:details:3: But there are just 15 minutes left before I'm overdue! Take him this batch, would you please? And hurry!
rows.quest:647:completion:0: Ah, nothing like Foggy ⟦E20⟧ to warm you up on a brisk day! And here I was thinking the little bugger was going to be overdue on his bills again. Thank you, friend! Many thanks indeed!
rows.quest:1132:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E22⟧ on the docks at ⟦E23⟧ in ⟦E24⟧.
rows.quest:1132:details:0: Oh, to be at sea once again! To feel the kiss of the wind, and to have the waves rock me like my blessed mother, long ago!
rows.quest:1132:details:1: Oh, I wish I had your fortune, good ⟦11⟧, for I see the sea in your future!
rows.quest:1132:details:2: It's my job to tell eager souls of the land of ⟦E25⟧, the land of opportunity! If you're willing to try your luck across the sea, then take a ship from here to the lovely port of ⟦E23⟧. Speak there with my partner, the elf, ⟦E22⟧.

rows.quest:1132:completion:0: Good day to you! You were sent by Mr. Flint in Menethil ⟦E2⟧? Well Mr. Flint is a strong judge of character. If he sent you, then there's no doubt you belong here in ⟦E25⟧!

rows.quest:465:details:0: While you were fighting the Dragonmaws, we discovered more of their plans.
rows.quest:465:details:1: Nek'rosh has built catapults and aims to lay siege to Menethil! And with the fighting in Dun Algaz, we're effectively blocked from reinforcements!
rows.quest:465:details:2: You need to take out those catapults. They're in the Dragonmaw encampment.
rows.quest:465:details:3: Here, take this tinder. Fight your way to the catapults and light them with the tinder.
rows.quest:465:details:4: And after you've done that, find and kill Nek'rosh. We need to cut this Dragonmaw beast down...at its neck.
rows.quest:465:progress:0: The first catapult is before you. Will you set it aflame?
rows.quest:465:completion:0: You place some of the tinder on the catapult then ⟦E28⟧ a ⟦E29⟧ onto it.
rows.quest:631:obj:0: Rhag Garmason wants you to locate Ol' Rustlocke.
rows.quest:631:details:0: A tremendous explosion roared through the hills. 'Twas horrible, I tell you!
rows.quest:631:details:1: Good soldiers died defending the Thandol Span. Longbraid says we'll take revenge on the Dark Irons before all is said and done.
rows.quest:631:details:2: We're in a world of hurt though and I don't see any reinforcements in sight. Longbraid sent Ol' Rustlocke to scout the eastern bridge to see if we could secure it.
rows.quest:631:details:3: That was days ago. We haven't the manpower to search for him with Dun Modr under siege.
rows.quest:631:completion:0: You search the tiny, dwarven corpse. Engraved into the helmet you can clearly read: Ebenezer Rustlocke.
rows.quest:632:obj:0: Report back to Rhag Garmason and show him the parchment you found on Rustlocke's corpse.
rows.quest:632:details:0: It seems as though poor Ol' Rustlocke ran into a Dark Iron ambush. You notice a parchment next to his clenched fist.
rows.quest:632:details:1: Report the grim news to Rhag Garmason and show him what you found.
rows.quest:632:completion:0: Oh my, the news is grave....
rows.quest:633:details:0: Heavens no! Poor Rustlocke. 'Tis quite a tragedy indeed.
rows.quest:633:details:1: We must not let his death pass in vain. This parchment you discovered indicates that Kam Deepfury, the mastermind behind the original attack, arranged for a cache of explosives to be stashed just across the Thandol Span, in ⟦E30⟧.
rows.quest:633:details:2: If those explosives make it to the bridge, our major supply line to the north will be severed! The cache must be destroyed, ⟦13⟧! Return to me when your mission is complete.
rows.quest:633:progress:0: The cache of explosives must be destroyed!
rows.quest:633:completion:0: The remaining bridge is saved! You have done a great service to King Magni and the people of Khaz Modan.
rows.quest:633:completion:1: Now if we can only hold out long enough for reinforcements to show...
rows.quest:634:obj:0: Seek out Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.

rows.quest:634:completion:1: But Stromgarde has fallen! Hence our presence here at Refuge Pointe. We are faced with retaking our own great city.
rows.quest:634:completion:2: Honor and duty require that we do not leave the Highlands until Stromgarde raises the mighty banner of the King once again. I will send word to Longbraid that he is on his own...

rows.quest:95646:details:0: These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.
rows.quest:95646:details:1: The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.
rows.quest:95646:details:2: Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's ⟦E36⟧ core.
rows.quest:95646:progress:0: These waters harbor unique life in a brine that gives and takes equally.
rows.quest:95647:title: Lost in the Thicket Things
rows.quest:95647:obj:0: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites.
rows.quest:95647:obj:1: * Learn what happened to Ardin Grassman
rows.quest:95647:details:0: My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.
rows.quest:95647:details:1: But I ⟦E18⟧ he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!
rows.quest:95647:details:2: If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.
